name: gamenet_player_row_list_append_new_row
description: GameNetPlayerRowList::AppendNewRow allocates a player row, constructs its embedded HUD panel, optionally zeroes the row, appends it to the list, increments the count, and returns the new row.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet player-row/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4345a0 validates allocation of a 0x310-byte GameNetPlayerRow, HudUiPanel::ConstructorDefault at row offset 0x64, optional row memset when zeroInitializeRow is nonzero, appending through self head/tail/count at offsets 0x04/0x08/0x0c, row next pointer at offset 0x30c, count increment, and returning the new row.

The native player-row append smoke verifies first and second append behavior through the global row-list overlay, head/tail/count updates, next-linking, zero-initialized row fields, and returned row pointers.
